commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

12' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Mohamed Salah plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Cody Gakpo (Liverpool). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.

12' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
11' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

11' What a wonderful moment! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the bottom left corner. His effort fails to surprise Stefan Ortega, who makes a nice save.
